title: One Task, Broken Down
body: Takes the thing you can't start and names the first physical action — then nine steps, then a space for what might stop you. £4, printable, use it as often as you like.
caption:

One Task, Broken Down takes the thing you can't start and names the first physical action — the actual first one, small enough to actually do. Then nine steps. Then a space for what might stop you, because that's the bit nobody plans for.

£4, printable, use it as many times as you like.

name: planner-made-for-one-brain
title: The Bespoke Planner
body: Every planner you have ever bought was built for someone else’s brain. Nine questions, and one gets made for yours — emailed as a printable PDF, usually within a couple of hours. £10.
caption:
Every planner you’ve ever bought was designed for somebody else’s brain. That’s why the third week is always blank. 🐸

The Bespoke Planner asks nine questions — how your day actually runs, how you track energy (spoons, battery, or please don’t), what you need on the page and what you need gone — and builds one for you. Emailed as a printable PDF, usually within a couple of hours.

£10. Made for one brain: yours.

name: planner-the-questions
title: Nine questions, one planner
body: Time-blocked or a list? Morning brain or evening brain? Spoons, battery, or no energy tracking at all? Big text and no italics? Answer, and the planner is built around it. £10, printable.
caption:
The questions the Bespoke Planner asks, so you know what you’re in for: 🐸

Time-blocked days, or a list? Does your brain arrive in the morning or the evening? Track energy as spoons, as a battery, or not at all? Do you want tasks broken into first steps? Which extras — sensory notes, safe foods, appointment prep, a joy log? Easy-read: bigger text, more space, no italics?

That’s most of it. Answer, and a planner is built around your answers and emailed to you. £10, print it as often as you like.

title: For the planner graveyard
body: The drawer of planners that lasted eleven days. Not a discipline problem — a fit problem. A planner built to your answers, £10, emailed as a PDF you can print forever.
caption:
Somewhere in your house there is a drawer of planners that each lasted about eleven days. 🐸

That was never a discipline problem. It was a fit problem — a layout designed for a brain that isn’t yours, and no amount of trying makes it fit.

The Bespoke Planner is built from your answers: your day shape, your energy, your extras, your text size. £10, emailed as a printable PDF, and when it needs changing you print a fresh one instead of buying another.
